component: RISK_OVERLAY_001 observed-liquidation forward telemetry mark-price stream

classification.root_cause: The Binance mark-price websocket timed out and reconnected during an otherwise row-count-valid collector chunk. The old coverage receipt checked total mark rows but did not check event-time continuity.

affected_range.effect: The full UTC day is incomplete under the preregistered missing-data rule and cannot be used as a development day, matched baseline day, validation day, or performance input.

containment.data_action: Do not backfill, interpolate, replace, or rewrite the sealed telemetry source. Exclude the affected UTC day from all later calculations.
containment.operational_action: Leave the bounded forward-only campaign running; later complete days remain eligible only after their own integrity replay.
containment.promotion_action: Block use of the affected day in overlay analysis and validation. A later analysis may use only the required number of replacement complete days; this overlay never authorizes orders.

reproducible_reaudit.expected_status: ACCUMULATING_DEVELOPMENT_WITH_EXCLUDED_DAYS until enough replacement complete days exist
reproducible_reaudit.implementation: quant/research/liquidation_history.py uses the collector's fixed 15-second receive timeout as the maximum permitted mark-price event silence.

prevention: Campaign status now replays full historical integrity rather than reporting only the latest manifest. Any later mark-stream interruption longer than the fixed receive timeout is surfaced as RUNNING_WITH_DATA_GAPS and excluded without changing the signal trigger or collection protocol.
closure_requirements: Preserve this incident and the original source bytes unchanged.
Maintain the affected-day exclusion on every later integrity replay.
Accumulate replacement complete forward days; do not reinterpret the excluded day as valid.
Keep live orders closed; this risk overlay never authorizes orders.
